intro: Welcome, brave adventurers, to the shadows of Alpha City — the world capital ruled by tyranny and oppression. The Overlords and their soulless AI council, The Singularity, hold absolute power over the blockchain-controlled society. In the darkness of the Underground, a rebellion stirs, led by the Glitchborn, Nodewalkers, Coinbrokers, and Chainbreakers. Your journey begins here, on the brink of revolution, in a city where every transaction, every thought, is monitored by the Overlords. Will you join the fight for freedom, or succumb to the digital tyranny that threatens to consume us all? The choice is yours…
